name: Hilton Head Branch Library Mahjong Club
description: Beaufort County Library System mah jongg club at its Hilton Head branch (Hilton Head Island, SC; about 35 miles from Savannah). Library's own page: "American mah jongg, which the library branches play, uses a card of standard hands, against which all games are played; these cards are changed annually." and "Each year, the National Mah Jongg League issues new cards." Free; everyone welcome whether new or experienced. A 3-part beginner series ran Jan 2026 (past).
address: Hilton Head Branch Library, Hilton Head Island, SC
schedule: Mondays 1:30-3:30pm (recurring; page: "Hilton Head Branch Library: Mondays 1:30 p.m. until 3:30 p.m.")
